ctx.x: We used to give all these things in churches in Charleston. Charleston was a city noted for its finer churches. They had a corner meeting house like they have today. You see Charleston had about 11 churches in it. All cathedral styles. Plush floors. Fine seats. Centenary church. Emanuel. Big Emanuel and Little Emanuel. But they were both magnitudes and size. A house. Thousands and more people. Balkans all around. Pipe organ. The biggest pipe she ever laid out on. And they chimed. And you can hear the chimes in…
Knew him personally. Knew him personally. Knew him personally.

He came to the band in Atlantic City while we were engaged on the boardwalk there. Young's Million Dollar Pear in Atlantic City was where the Jenkins band was playing. When Scott Joplin walked out and brought his rag. The Maple Leaf Rag. Right. Then he brought- The first I ever heard of the Bolo Rag. Sweet Meats. And then I don't know whether he wrote Temptation or not but those four were the featured rags with the band.
